rows.grounds: first member of compound denoting ritual offering
second member of compound denoting reception or acceptance
neuter noun indicating defining mark or definition

items.question: What defining characteristic constitutes oblation as acceptance in this ritual act?
premises: Homa denotes a ritual oblation or offering.
Svīkāra denotes the act of acceptance.
Lakṣaṇam specifies the defining characteristic of something.
items.inference: The defining characteristic of homa is the acceptance of the offering.
uncertainties: The precise referent of what is accepted depends on the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: This is the characteristic of oblation: acceptance.
